channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Deadly strike hits market in Yemen’s Taiz
item.description: A strike on a market in the Yemeni city of Taiz has killed at least seven people and wounded 40.

item.title: Israeli strikes continue in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
item.description: An Israeli Apache helicopter struck a commercial centre near Mayfadoun in Southern Lebanon.

item.title: Three killed, four injured in shooting at Detroit, Michigan, strip club
item.description: Police say the US shooting followed an altercation at an after-hours venue, and four people are in hospital.

item.title: Why has Trump rejected Iran’s peace proposal?
item.description: The US president has reportedly threatened to resume strikes on Iran.

item.title: Bill Gates says AI without regulation is ‘completely irresponsible’
item.description: The billionaire cofounder of Microsoft says, without restrictions, AI could 'cause a billion deaths'.

item.title: ‘Iran ready for doomsday war’, FM Araghchi says
item.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Iran is prepared for war to resume, ‘even if it comes to a doomsday war’.

item.title: Mike Waltz: US offered to sell Iran uranium for civilian programme
item.description: US ambassador says Iran refused to agree to an arrangement where uranium would be supplied by Washington.

item.title: Dozens killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
item.description: At least 27 people have been killed in two mass shootings across South Africa.

item.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
item.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
item.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.
